neighbours.label: Spelling unit: the suffix piece (-ated / -ender / -ater) that completes a word starting with a short b- / be- / bel- stub, as in belated, bender, Bender, berated; strongest on 'belated'. Lateness without that word (late, tardy, overdue) stays quiet, and the same suffixes on other stems (lender, blender, debated, elated) are weak or silent.
fire: I finally mailed her a belated birthday card.
The company issued a belated apology to customers.
Officials made a belated effort to fix the bridge.
He went on a weekend bender after the breakup.
The sailors went on a wild bender in port.
Bender, the robot, cracked another joke.
The coach berated the referee after the game.
His mother berated him for the broken window.

The company issued a tardy apology to customers.
Officials made an overdue effort to fix the bridge.
He went to a weekend lender after the breakup.
The sailors bought a wild blender in port.
The fender of the robot cracked again.
The coach debated the referee after the game.
His mother was elated about the new window.
